book.name: Matayo
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Matayo

content: Yesu abhatangazi bhandu pachitombi
Yesu paaghaweni mapogha gha bhandu, akakweliki pachitombi, na kutama. Bhabhulwa bhaki bhakunjendile,
jombi akatumbwi kubhabhola, akapwaghaje:
Chiheku cha Chakaka

content.text: maghambu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde nde wabhu!”
“Bhapengaliki bhabhabhi na injala na inywita ja kutenda ghaaghapala Chapanga,
Bhapengaliki bhabhang'ahikwa kwa ndandi ja kutenda ghaaghapala Chapanga,
maghambu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde nde wabhu.

content: “Mpengaliki mwehapa bhandu pabhuntondola, na kung'aha na kundongalela kila lilobhi lihakau kwa ndandi jangu.
Muhekalyaye na kululuta, maghambu nhupu winu nde ukolongwa kunani kumahunde. Maghambu anana nde mobhang'ahakakile bhalota bhaka Chapanga bhabhatamika mangani yinu.”
Mwinyu na Unang'anu

“Mwehapa nde mwinyu wa pundema. Nambu mwinyu anauhoiki kunogha kwaki, bho, anaujeghalika kiki nahuli unogha kabhete? Ngacheijangatila kwa chindu chokapi, nambu kutaghakika kunja na kukanyatwa na bhandu.”
“Mwehapa nde unang'anu wa pundema. Muchi ghouchengakiki panani ja chitombi ngacheuweza kulihiya.
Nga mundu joapambaki taa na kujikupakila kwa chihulu, nambu abheka panani ja kinala nahuli jabhamulakya bhandu bhokapi bhabhabhi mkati ja nyumba.
Bhelabhela unang'anu winu na unang'anaje palongi ja bhandu, nahuli bhaghabhona matendu ghinu manyahi, na bhombi bhundumbalya Atati winu joabhi kunani kumahunde.”
Mabholu panani ja Shelia
“Ngamwiholakela kubha nhikiki kubhoha Shelia au mabholu gha bhalota bhaka Chapanga. Nepani ngachenhikiki kubhoha, nambu kutimiza.
Numpwaghi chakaka, mbaka panihapa kunani kumahunde na pundema pakwipetaje, njeta hata chindu kichokopi chechibhohakika mu Shelia, mbaka ghokapi ghatimilaje.

Bhela, mundu jokapi joanahekatayi amuli jimu njoku jejibhi mu Shelia jokapi, na kubhabhola bhandu bhangi kutenda bhelabhela, mundu jonihoju anaakubha nchoku nakanopi mu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde. Nambu mundu jola joakamulakila na kubhawola bhandu bhangi bhahenga bhenibhela, jonihoju anaakubha nkolongwa mu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde.
Henu numpwaghi kubha, impalika kujetakela na kuhenga ghaaghapala Chapanga, kupeta mobhahengela bhabhola bha Shelia na Mafalisayo, nanga bhela nganjingili mu Ukolongwa wa kunani kumahunde ng'o.”
Mabholu ghaghakanakila kubha na inyela
“Njowini bhandu bha mwandi bhakapwaghakiki, ‘Ngawikoma, na mundu anaakomiki impalika utemulo.’

Nambu nenga numpwaghila, jokapi joanhyomela ndongu waki, impalika utemulo. Na mundu joantondola ndongu waki, impalika kutemuliwa pachengu. Mundu anaampwaghili ndongu waki, ‘Ung'ang'a,’ impalika kujingila mu moto wa jehanamu.
Bhela anaupeleka nyambiku jaku palongi ja chihanja cha nyambiku, na panihapa anaukombwiki kubha ndongu waku alochini na wenga,
jileka nyambiku jaku palongi ja chihacha cha nyambiku, jenda hoti ukajongana na ndongu waku, na panihapa nde ukelabhukaje ubhoha nyambiku jaku.”

“Jonganaje na ntakila waku manyata mkabya mwakona mwindela kujenda pachengu. Nanga bhela ntakila waku anaakupelaka kwaka nkolongwa wa pachengu, najombi nkolongu wa pachengu anaakupelaka kwaka linjolinjoli, na wenga anaukongakikaje muchifungo.
Nukupwaghi chakaka, ngaupiti monihomu mbaka undepaje sendi ja kujomukela.”
Mabholu gha kukanakila Ugone
“Njowini kubha bhandu bhakapwaghakiki, ‘Ngamwihenga ugone.’
Nambu nepani numpwaghila, kila mundu joandingali mbomba kwa kuntokulela, ajomwi kutenda ugone mumtima waki.
Bhela ngati lihu laku la kumalelelu likuhokili, litupulaje ukalilekala kutali. Mbanga nakanopi kwaku kuhobheha pandu pa hyegha jaku, kuliku hyegha jaku jokapi kulekaleka mu moto wa Jehanamu.
Ngati chiwoku chaku cha kumalelelu chikuhokii, uhekataje ukalekala kutali. Mbanga kwaku kuhobheha pandu pa hyegha jaku, kuliko hyegha jaku jokapi kulekaleka mu moto wa jehanamu.”
Mabholu gha kukanakila Kulekana
“Ipwaghakiki kubha, ‘Mundu joandeka nhwanu waki, impalika ampekya baluwa ja kundeka.’

Nambu nepani numpwaghila, kila mwanalomi joampekeha nhwanu waki baluwa ja kulekana, nambu pena kwa lihoku la ugone, untenda abya mgone. Na mwanalomi anaantotwili mbomba joapatiki baluwa ja kulekana jola, najombi atenda ugone.”
Mabholu gha kukanakila Kulapa
“Kabhete, njowini kubha bhandu bha mwandi mobhakapwaghile, ‘Ngawiheketa kulapa kwaku, nambu ipalakika utimizaye kulapa kwaku palongi jaka Bambo.’
Nambu nepani numpwaghila, ngamwilapa ng'o, wala kwa kunani kumahunde, maghambu nde mpandu waki wa Ukolongwa waka Chapanga,
wala kwa pundema, maghambu nde mpandu wa kubhekela magholu ghaki, wala kwa Yelusalemu, maghambu nde muchi waka Nkolongwa.
Wala ngawilapa kwa mmutu waku, maghambu ngauwezi kuling'anambula hata lijunju limu kubha lihuhu au lipili.
Pampwagha, ‘Ena,’ mpwagha pena, ‘Ena,’ au pampwagha ‘Ngabhela’ mpwagha pena, ‘Ngabehla,’ kwa ndandi malobhi ghaghapwaghakika, kupeta ghanihagha ghahuma kwaka Mhakau jola.
Mabholu gha kukanakila kulepa Kisasi
“Njowini kubha ipwaghakiki, ‘Lihu kwa lihu, na linu kwa linu.’
Nambu nepani numpwaghila, ngamwankelabhukila mundu mhakau. Ngati mundu anaakulapwili lighanja litukwa la kumalelelu, ung'anambulyaje akulapulaje na la kumangeja.
Ngati mundu joapala kukutakila nahuli kukunyaghu lishati laku, undekila na likoti bhelabhela.
Mundu jokapi anaakujomalakela kutotola chibwahila chaki kilometa jimu, totulaje kilometa ibheli.
Mundu anaakujopiki chindu umpekyaje, na mundu joapala kukujahika chindu kwaku ngawanjima.
Kubhapala Maadui
“Njowini kubha ikapwaghakiki, ‘Umpala njako, na unhakalya adui waku.’
Nambu nepani numpwaghila, mwapala maadui bhinu, mwapengalya bhala bhabhung'aha, na mwahengila manyahi bhala bhabhunhakalila, na mwalobhilaje bhala bhabhuntende mahakau,

nahuli mpata kubha bhana bha Atati winu joabhi kunani kumahunde. Maghambu jombi abhamulakila lyobha laki bhandu bhahakau na bhambone, na kubhatonyela iyula bhandu bhambone palongi jaka Chapanga na bhahakau.
Maghambu anamwapaliki bhandu bhabhumpala mwehapa pena, bho, anampata nyonjeka bhole? Njeta! Maghambu hata bhajopa kode bhatenda ghanihagha!
Ngati anamubhalamuki bhalongu bhinu pela, bho, mtenda chindu bhole cha nyonjeka kupeta bhangi? Hata bhandu bhanga kummanya Chapanga bhatenda ghanihagha!
Bhela impalika mwehapa kubha bhakamilifu, ngati Atati winu joabhi kunani kumahunde moabheli mkamilifu.
